items.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
items.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
items.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

items.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
items.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

items.headline: NVIDIA Launches Vera CPU Platform for High-Performance Computing
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the 'NVIDIA Vera CPU' rack-scale platform, its first custom data center CPU designed for high-performance scientific modeling and simulation.

items.headline: Thread AI Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
items.summary: Thread AI has been accepted into the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, providing the company with access to Azure AI models and enterprise-grade support.

items.headline: Microsoft Addresses Recent 365 Service Disruption
items.summary: Microsoft has implemented new service health check methods and automated recovery systems following a global disruption to its 365 services that occurred between November 12 and 14, 2026.

items.headline: TD Cowen Adjusts Broadcom Price Target to $425 From $475
items.summary: TD Cowen has revised its price target for Broadcom Inc. to $425, down from the previous target of $475.

items.headline: Capri Holdings Insider Sold Shares Worth $46.9 Million
items.summary: A corporate insider at Capri Holdings Limited executed a sale of company shares valued at approximately $46.9 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

items.headline: Imperial Brands Reports FY26 Financial Results
items.summary: Imperial Brands announced its full-year 2026 financial results, reporting an increase in adjusted profit despite a decline in overall revenue.

items.headline: Imperial Brands Announces Workforce Reduction Plan Through 2030
items.summary: Imperial Brands has unveiled a strategic plan to reduce its workforce by up to 4,600 positions by the end of 2030 as part of a cost-management initiative.

items.headline: Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun Discusses AI Strategy and Smart Manufacturing at APEC
items.summary: At the APEC meeting, Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun outlined the company's vision for future AI-integrated products and the development of fully automated smart factories.

items.headline: HSBC Sells $300 Million Loan Tied to Project Jupiter
items.summary: HSBC has sold a $300 million loan associated with 'Project Jupiter' amid ongoing regulatory challenges.

items.headline: Shell Subsidiary Commences Gas Production in Malaysia
items.summary: A Shell subsidiary has officially started production from gas fields located in Malaysia.

items.headline: Zurich Insurance Increases Synergy Targets from Beazley Integration
items.summary: Zurich Insurance Group has raised its expected synergy targets resulting from the integration of Beazley.

items.headline: HUYA Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
items.summary: HUYA Inc. released its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of $261.4 million.

items.headline: BP Appoints New Independent Directors and Senior Independent Director
items.summary: BP has announced the appointment of two new independent non-executive directors and a new senior independent director as part of an ongoing leadership reshuffle and business restructuring.

items.headline: Weibo Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
items.summary: Weibo Corporation reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026.

items.headline: Valeura Energy Inc. Receives TSX Approval for New Normal Course Issuer Bid
items.summary: Valeura Energy Inc. has secured Toronto Stock Exchange approval for a new share buyback program, set to run from November 2026 through November 2027.

items.headline: Elsevier Releases Study on AI's Impact on Academic Librarianship
items.summary: Elsevier, a subsidiary of RELX, published a study indicating that 83% of academic librarians view artificial intelligence as a primary driver of change in research, while 81% express concerns regardin

items.headline: Tencent Launches Hy4 Flash AI Model
items.summary: Tencent has announced the release of Hy4 flash, the latest addition to its Hy model family, featuring 224 billion total parameters.

items.headline: Atos-Accenture Consortium Selected for French National Health Insurance Fund Project
items.summary: The Atos-Accenture consortium has been selected by the French National Health Insurance Fund (Cnam) to manage and secure the Shared Medical Record (DMP) and integrate it with Mon Espace Santé.

items.headline: Regulatory Disclosure: Form 8.5 (EPT/RI) Regarding CAB Payments Holdings plc
items.summary: A regulatory disclosure (Form 8.5) was published on November 16, 2026, concerning dealings in the securities of CAB Payments Holdings plc during its ongoing offer period.

items.headline: Quadrise Secures Partial Site License Fee Payment for US Project
items.summary: Quadrise plc has received a US$300,000 payment from Valkor Technologies LLC as part of a site license fee for its project in Utah, USA.

items.headline: FirstGroup Reports Growth in Adjusted Pre-Tax Profit and Revenue for First Half
items.summary: FirstGroup plc announced an increase in its adjusted pre-tax profit and revenue for the first half of the 2026 fiscal year.

items.headline: Origin Enterprises plc Reports Q1 Revenue
items.summary: Origin Enterprises plc reported revenue of EUR 569.5 million for the first quarter of the fiscal year.

items.headline: Saga plc Initiates Up to GBP300 Million Notes Offering
items.summary: Saga plc has announced the initiation of a notes offering of up to GBP 300 million to facilitate the repayment of a term loan.

items.headline: EDX Medical Group Appoints Martin Walton as CEO
items.summary: EDX Medical Group has appointed Deputy Chairman Martin Walton as its new CEO, effective immediately, succeeding Michael Hudson.

items.headline: EDX Medical Group CEO Executes 'Bed and ISA' Share Transfer
items.summary: CEO Dr. Michael Hudson performed a 'Bed and ISA' transfer of shares, reallocating his holdings between accounts.

items.headline: Newmark Security Ends Takeover Talks Following Shareholder Rejection
items.summary: Newmark Security plc has terminated takeover discussions after Thalassa Holdings Ltd, a significant shareholder, rejected the proposed offer.

items.headline: Synthomer Appoints New Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Synthomer plc has announced the appointment of a new Chief Financial Officer.

items.headline: The Pebble Group plc: Purchase of Shares by Employee Benefit Trust
items.summary: The Pebble Group plc announced that its Employee Benefit Trust has purchased shares of the company.

items.headline: Acuity RM Group Announces Further Contract Award for STREAM Platform
items.summary: Acuity RM Group has secured a new contract to deploy a second on-premises instance of its STREAM platform for a prime defence contractor.

items.headline: Acuity RM Group Announces Exercise of Share Warrants
items.summary: Acuity RM Group has received notices for the exercise of warrants resulting in the issuance of 4,250,000 new ordinary shares.
